messages:
auditor_sam: Hi team We need a compact evidence bundle for the RBAC change and KMS activity during the maintenance window on 2025-06-20. Deliverables: approval trail (Okta/GitHub), infra diff (Terraform plan/apply), k8s audit lines showing RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding edits, CloudTrail/GCP-KMS decrypt/GenerateDataKey events, and key rotation proof. Please map each artifact to SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO A.9/A.10.

maya_sre: assigning. Quick Q: you want AWS CloudTrail format or also GCP-style entries if the key came from GCP KMS? This incident touched our multi-cloud test key wrap.

auditor_sam: machine-readable preferred. Include both if available and call out which cloud each event came from. A README with one-line control mapping per file + checksums (sha256) is required.

oliver_sec: context: change added serviceAccount `inference-sidecar` to ClusterRoleBinding `inference-deployers`. PR #5001 (sha: ea77c2). Terraform run_id: tf-apply-20250620-09. Deploy correlation id: deploy-20250620-09. We used AWS CMK alias/redwood-cache-2025 and a GCP keyring rewrap for cross-region caching.

tara_ops: I merged PR #5001 and kicked the apply. Okta event id okta_evt_6009 for approver Tara Ops. I'll export the Okta audit event and the GitHub webhook.

ci-bot: terraform run completed: tf-apply-20250620-09; plan: +1 service_account; status: success; artifact sha256:abc123...; deploy_id: deploy-20250620-09.

maya_sre: example sanitized k8s audit snippet we'll include:
{"stageTimestamp":"2025-06-20T05:12:03Z","verb":"patch","user":{"username":"tara_ops","uid":"U-1302"},"objectRef":{"resource":"clusterrolebindings","name":"inference-deployers"},"requestObject":{"changes":"+subjects:[{kind:ServiceAccount,name:inference-sidecar}]"}}

oliver_sec: sample AWS CloudTrail KMS event (sanitized):
{"eventTime":"2025-06-20T05:13:27Z","eventName":"GenerateDataKey","userIdentity":{"type":"AssumedRole","arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/inference-runtime-role/runner"},"resources":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/11aa-22bb-33cc"],"requestParameters":{"encryptionContext":{"deploy_id":"deploy-20250620-09","pr_sha":"ea77c2"}}}

oliver_sec: sample GCP KMS event (sanitized):
{"timestamp":"2025-06-20T05:14:01Z","methodName":"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt","principalEmail":"inference-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com","resourceName":"projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/cache/cryptoKeys/redis-key","request":"...","labels":{"deploy_id":"deploy-20250620-09","pr_sha":"ea77c2"}}

auditor_sam: nice. Two asks: 1) include a timeline.txt that LINEARLY maps PR#5001 -> tf-apply-20250620-09 -> k8s patch -> AWS/GCP KMS events 2) compute sha256 for every artifact and include checksums.sha256. Also annotate any redactions.

maya_sre: plan: produce README.md (file->control mapping), timeline.txt, k8s-audit.jsonl, cloudtrail-aws.jsonl, gcp-kms.jsonl, terraform-apply.log, pr-diff.patch, okta-events.jsonl, keypolicy-aws.pdf, keypolicy-gcp.pdf, checksums.sha256. I will upload to s3://redwood-audit/multi-cloud/2025-06-20/1899990000_bundle.zip and gcs://redwood-audit/multi-cloud/2025-06-20/1899990000_bundle.zip for redundancy.

tara_ops: I will add a one-line signed approval note and export the Okta JSON event.

ci-bot: bundles uploaded: s3://redwood-audit/multi-cloud/2025-06-20/1899990000_bundle.zip (sha256: d3f2e1...); gcs://redwood-audit/multi-cloud/2025-06-20/1899990000_bundle.zip; presigned links DM'd.

auditor_sam: received links. We'll review and return any deeper raw-event requests. Post-audit suggestion: auto-populate deploy_id into both AWS KMS encryptionContext and GCP KMS labels. Filing SEC-800 for deploy_id propagation. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
